notes: Payer mix and reimbursement are from general knowledge, not the evidence.

healthcare_provider_setting.value: Physician group practice delivering care inside partner hospitals (NICUs, labor and delivery), its own practices, and via telehealth

clinical_specialty.value: Neonatology, maternal-fetal medicine, OB hospitalist medicine, and pediatric specialty and critical care

payer_revenue_mix.value: Mix of commercial insurers and government programs, notably Medicaid-heavy given the newborn and NICU population

payment_reimbursement_model.value: Predominantly fee-for-service physician billing, plus hospital administrative support and coverage fees from partner hospitals

setting_specific_capacity.value: Operates across many states, partnering with a large number of hospitals and a large base of affiliated clinicians

patient_acuity_case_mix.value: High-acuity: complex and high-risk pregnancies, premature and critically ill newborns, and critically ill children

clinical_operating_quality.value: Center for Research, Education, Quality and Safety; evidence-based medicine and quality initiatives, no specific outcome metric given
